summary: Iteration 11 — verified Iteration-14 UI/UX changes (EventDetailsModal intermediate step, NotifyModal city dropdown, separate Coming Soon Leads admin tab, Experts 'Tap for More Information', Hero 'Get Notified' smooth-scroll, Collection autoplay). 32/32 backend pytest pass (added 11 new tests for /api/notify-interest public POST + admin GET/filter/export). 14/15 frontend Playwright assertions pass. ONE REAL BUG FOUND: Collection autoplay (Collection.jsx) does not advance — `el.scrollLeft += 0.45` per frame is floored to 0 by the browser so position never accumulates.

ui_bugs.issue: Track does NOT auto-scroll. scrollLeft remains 0 indefinitely. Root cause: in /app/frontend/src/components/sections/Collection.jsx line 18, `el.scrollLeft += SPEED` where SPEED=0.45 — browsers floor scrollLeft to an integer, so each frame writes scrollLeft=0.45, reads back 0, adds 0.45, writes 0.45, reads back 0… Net delta is always 0. Hover-no-pause and manual arrows DO work (manual scrollBy(320) works fine), but the continuous autoplay requirement is broken.

action_items: (MINOR) Effect cleanup: in Collection.jsx the rAF cleanup `cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current)` cancels the *currently-pending* frame, but if a tick has already overwritten rafRef.current with the next id, cancellation can still race in StrictMode. Consider using an `alive` flag captured in closure: `let alive = true; ...if (!alive) return; ... return () => { alive = false; cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current); };`

rca_of_the_issue: Collection autoplay bug RCA — `el.scrollLeft = 0.45` is silently floored by browsers (Chrome/Firefox/Safari) to integer pixel values, so the increment is lost every frame. Each rAF tick reads `el.scrollLeft` (=0), adds 0.45, writes 0.45, but the next read returns 0 again. Need to maintain a JS-side float accumulator and only assign integer-rounded values to scrollLeft; OR bump SPEED to >=1 so the floored increment is at least 1px/frame. Reproduction: open homepage, scroll to Collection section, evaluate `document.querySelector('[data-testid=collection-track]').scrollLeft` — stays 0 indefinitely. Mitigation in action_items.
